scripts.build: npm run build -w @starhold/game && npm run build -w @starhold/server && npm run build -w @starhold/web && npm run bundle:api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @starhold/game && concurrently -n game,server,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @starhold/game" "npm run dev -w @starhold/server" "npm run dev -w @starhold/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @starhold/game && npm run typecheck -w @starhold/server && npm run typecheck -w @starhold/web
